name: OpenAI API (GPT-4o)
cost: Free tier available for new users, then pay-as-you-go. GPT-4o is highly capable.
capability: Advanced language model for text generation, summarization, and style transfer, callable via API.
integration_path: Python libraries like `openai` allow easy integration. Can be used to analyze and rewrite emails based on provided tone and format guidelines.

name: Hugging Face Transformers (LLaMA 3, Mistral)
cost: Open source models, free to download and run. Requires self-hosting infrastructure.
capability: Provides access to a wide range of open-source LLMs that can be fine-tuned for specific writing tasks like tone adjustment and format adherence.
integration_path: Python's `transformers` library allows loading and running these models. Fine-tuning on example client emails could achieve tone matching.

name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
cost: Free to use with generous rate limits for API access. Part of existing Google Workspace.
capability: Offers access to powerful Gemini models for text generation and editing, with a user-friendly interface and API access.
integration_path: Python SDK available. Can be prompted to rewrite emails with specific tone and format instructions. Potential integration with Gmail via Google Apps Script.

name: Local LLM Inference with Ollama
cost: Free to download and run open-source LLMs locally. Requires sufficient hardware.
capability: Simplifies running various open-source LLMs (like Llama 3, Mistral) on a local machine, enabling self-hosted AI writing assistance.
integration_path: Ollama provides a REST API that can be called from Python. Self-hosting ensures privacy for sensitive correspondence.

name: Grammarly (Free Tier)
cost: Free tier offers basic grammar and spelling checks. Premium features for tone and style require subscription.
capability: Provides real-time writing feedback, including suggestions for clarity and tone, though advanced tone matching is limited in the free version.
integration_path: Browser extension or desktop app. Limited API access for free users. Primarily manual use for John Loucks.

name: Hugging Face Transformers (with fine-tuned models)
cost: Open source, free to use.  Self-hosting has infrastructure costs.
capability: Access to a vast array of open-source LLMs that can be fine-tuned for specific writing styles, tone correction, and format adherence.
integration_path: Python library integration. Requires model selection and potentially fine-tuning on John Loucks' email data for optimal performance.

name: Google AI Studio (Gemini Pro)
cost: Free tier with generous limits, potentially covered by existing Google Workspace.
capability: Offers a user-friendly interface and API for text generation and editing, with capabilities for style and tone adjustment.
integration_path: REST API integration with Python. Can be prompted to adopt specific tones and formats.

name: OpenAI GPT-3.5 Turbo (via API)
cost: Free tier available for limited usage, then pay-as-you-go pricing. Likely falls within existing Google/Max subscriptions for API access.
capability: A powerful language model that can be prompted to rewrite text for tone, format, and focus, and can be integrated via API.
integration_path: Python can interact with the OpenAI API using the 'openai' library. Prompts would need to be carefully crafted to specify tone, format, and focus requirements.

name: Hugging Face Transformers (Open Source Models)
cost: Open Source (free to download and run). Costs are associated with hosting/compute if self-hosted.
capability: Provides access to a vast library of open-source LLMs that can be fine-tuned or prompted for specific writing style transfer and tone correction.
integration_path: Python integration is straightforward using the 'transformers' library. Requires more technical expertise to set up and manage for specific tasks like tone matching.

integration_path: Integrates with Python via the Google Cloud client libraries. Similar to OpenAI, requires prompt engineering for desired outcomes.
